passages.title: Unit variance and exact displayed rate
passages.inference: The given average second moments yield unit diagonal covariance of the centered independent normalized sum. Substitutingδ=B/sqrt n gives exactly the displayed logarithm and outside factor, with hn≥1 and zero algebraic branches handled.

passages.title: Apply Theorem1 with absolute constant before all models
passages.inference: Apply the actual intrinsic bounded-envelope theorem to that normalized array and its genuine covariance factor. The public theorem places one positive absolute C before Ω,p,n,X,B,A and retains ordinary independent-centered-bounded inputs, not i.i.d. or a spectral lower bound.

checked_expanded_types.name: RectangleCLTArxivV1.normalizedObservationsIntrinsicCLT
checked_expanded_types.expanded_type:
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω}
  [inst_1 : MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure μ] {p n : ℕ} {X : Fin n → Ω → RectangleCLT.Vector p} {B : ℝ},
  RectangleCLT.BoundedIndependentHypotheses μ X B →
    1 ≤ p →
      1 ≤ n →
        (∀ (j : Fin p), 1 / ↑n * ∑ i, ∫ (ω : Ω), X i ω j ^ 2 ∂μ = 1) →
          ∀ (A : Matrix (Fin p) (Fin p) ℝ),
            A * A.transpose = RectangleCLT.covariance μ (RectangleCLT.Companion.normalizedObservationSum X) →
              RectangleCLT.Companion.rectangleDistance μ (RectangleCLT.Companion.normalizedObservationSum X) A ≤
                RectangleCLTArxivV1.intrinsicUniversalConstant *
                  min 1
                    (RectangleCLTArxivV1.intrinsicObservationRate B (RectangleCLTArxivV1.gaussianMaximumMean A) n
                      (RectangleCLT.dimensionLog p))
